subject: Re: Kickoff: streaming keyword spotting for the wake-word stack (Project Riverbed)
body:
Priya,

Riverbed resourcing:

Staffing: Linnea 60% as tech lead on the streaming wrappers and conversion path; Vera 50% on training runs and eval; Giannis 40% on the device-lab harness; Rafael 15% advisory only — he's spread across two other language efforts, so please don't route review load his way.

Compute: training is small-model work — 8-16 Titan A100s best-effort covers the model-family sweeps. No reservations. The scarce resource is the device lab: we need recurring slots on the DSP-class boards for the July latency readout. Zeke, cc'd — can Shipyard give us two half-days a week from mid-June?

Technical constraint to note: the functional Keras API path doesn't support the dynamic train/inference topologies, so we standardize on the subclassing route the release recommends. That constrains how we export to the on-device runtime, and Linnea wants a spike week in May to de-risk the conversion before we promise bit-exactness.

Alina
